title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: governance policies check outgoing emails before they are sent
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, governance paths, documented Dataverse operations and Copilot credits prerequisite are supported. It correctly reports Microsoft's conflicting descriptions of whether a blocked email can be overridden. A minor correction remains because the checklist directs readers to manage controls that the controls table does not represent.

claims.claim: Policy evaluation uses AI judgement rather than just deterministic rule matching.
claims.quote: Score threshold for violation determination. LLM score less than threshold equals violated, score greater than or equal to threshold equals pass.

claims.claim: The checklist directs readers to manage several controls that have no corresponding controls-table row.
claims.quote: Checklist: role privileges, credits setup, cross-region consent, AI agents, simulation, custom Send validation, logs and consumption. Table: Whether governance is turned on for the environment; Creation of governance policy records.
claims.fix: Remove checklist instructions to take stock of role privileges, check credits setup, provide cross-region consent, enable AI agents, run simulations, check custom Send integration, review logs and monitor credits where no corresponding row exists. Retain their sourced explanatory prose; do not add control rows.
